plugins.text: Panes and plugins built on rux

how.text:
Every artboard is built from the Black Rainbow Labs Rux design system (Rux.*), so changing a component there changes it everywhere here.

The Ul* components are Unluminous's own window as it is drawn today; the rest are rux. Colours are the ul-* and rux tokens, which follow the theme set on each artboard's root (unluminous-dark or unluminous-light).

To carry a design back to Rust: a token change goes into crates/unluminous-app/src/theme/mod.rs, a rux component change into black-rainbow-labs-rux, and an icon into theme::icon. design/claude-design/README.md in the repository says where each piece lives.
